skills.reviewNote: Original damage and DEF-break records retained. Reviewed 4.5x physical hit followed by +20% incoming physical damage for 3 enemy phases, not the original DEF formula. review.note: Daniel compared Memorial Edition directly: short forward movement, blue target effect, one hit and break, no standard attack clip.
